blurb: Big Basin Vineyards offers wine club memberships with four levels providing quarterly wine shipments and tasting benefits. They host events including a Douro River wine cruise and Happy Hour Thursdays at their Santa Cruz Tasting Room. Private events can be held at their Downtown Santa Cruz Tasting Room with food and wine offerings.
